integrity: The infinite argument is a direct Kummer carry proof: one explicit selected coefficient excludes every smaller multiplier, while every selected coefficient at the target has exactly two carries. A standalone standard-library script provides finite corroboration only.
limitations: The theorem is confined to the natural boundary family m=p+1 and does not classify least extremal rows for arbitrary moduli of p-adic height two. Absolute bibliographic novelty cannot be certified by search.
title: The omitted \(a=1\) boundary: \(T_p(p+1)=p(p+1)\)
